  - region "Simple English explanation of Reflection in Point":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Reflection in Point" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Reflection in a point sends each point through a centre to an image the same distance away. In Reflection in Point, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. You can learn Reflection in Point by trying one small example instead of long theory.
    - paragraph: Draw a line from the point through the centre. Continue the same distance beyond the centre to place the image. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, logo symmetry: Opposite parts can match through a centre. Watch out: Putting the image on the line but not equally far. The centre must be the midpoint."
